AaveV3InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V3 instance. Instance set on NAVCalculator via addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances (each entry = ProtocolDataProvider address). Supersedes per-instance AaveV3_* adapters, disabled below.

CompoundV3CometsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Compound V3 comet. Supersedes per-instance CompoundV3_* adapters, disabled below.

UniswapV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Pre-provisioned, DEPLOYED BUT NOT REGISTERED on the NAV. Enabled here so 04 deploys it at its CREATE2 address; deliberately ABSENT from nav-config/meta-balance-adapters/10.json, which is the file 06_Configure reads, so no registration happens until the funds actually hold Uniswap V3 positions on this chain. Registering it now would add an adapter that reports nothing to every NAV read. To activate: add it to nav-config with its instance set and run 06.

LidoStakedEthWalletMeta.$comment: Wallet-held yield tokens (ADR 0010 meta family). Reports the RAW balanceOf of a token that is itself a registered, priced NAV asset, so the reported amount is bit-identical to what ERC20DefaultBalanceAdapter reported for the same holding - this reclassifies wstETH (Lido) from a generic wallet holding to a Staking position and changes NO value. Constructor takes only the NAV proxy, so the CREATE2 address is identical on every chain. The governed token set lives on NAVCalculator (see nav-config); claiming a token there automatically disarms the default adapter for it, so the two can never both report the same holding.
